summary: Victims invested funds into a platform called BG Wealth Sharing and later encountered blocked withdrawals while operators demanded identity documents and facial verification images. Community responses warned the operation had entered a final extraction phase where scammers attempted to collect additional sensitive data and exploit victims through recovery scam tactics.
user_mistake: sent funds to an unverified investment platform and considered sharing identity documents
prevention: refuse requests for identity documents from unverified investment groups/report fraudulent platforms to authorities immediately
